correction.incorrect_implementation: Equality of raw occurrence counts for each marker in two complete Scribd UI replays.
correction.correct_implementation: Equality of the boolean presence/absence vector for the four mandatory textual markers after each snapshot has already passed its per-snapshot geometry gate.

unchanged.source_authority: John A. Wilson / AJSL / University of Chicago / JSTOR
unchanged.frozen_locus: THE POEM, journal pp.266-278; Record excluded

rationale: The frozen gate used the term marker vector and separately required each marker's presence and geometry. Counting duplicated UI occurrences is representation-level noise and was never frozen as a semantic cross-timestamp invariant. The correction aligns code with the pre-existing gate rather than weakening the gate after seeing data.
